mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.resource_type, p.url, p.parent_id, p.sort_order, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.parent_id NULLS FIRST, p.sort_order, p.id
